# Nima Aref

> Nima Aref is a product engineer based in Franklin, Tennessee, who builds AI systems end to end: agents, retrieval and the cloud infrastructure they run on. He is Lead Product Engineer at Omega Business Solutions, co-founder of Sightline (an Omega venture), and Technical Lead & Development Consultant at InPaceline. He also takes on a small number of freelance projects.

## Current work

- Omega Business Solutions, Lead Product Engineer (April 2026 to present): delivers AI systems end to end, from architecture through production deployment.
- Sightline, co-founder: developer tooling that gives engineering teams visibility into, and guardrails around, the AI coding agents they use.
- InPaceline, Technical Lead & Development Consultant (May 2025 to present): leads product and engineering for InPaceline OS and consults for founders building their own products.
- Freelance developer (2024 to present): AI systems, web apps and websites for small businesses and founders.

## Selected work

- Gut Girls Hub (2026): paid membership portal and marketing site for a gut-health coaching business. Next.js, Firebase, Cloud Functions, Stripe. https://www.gutgirls.health
- Fit + Faith 615 (2026): community website with a self-serve CMS and HubSpot sign-ups on Cloudflare Workers, plus an offline-first QR wristband app for event lead capture. https://fitandfaith615.com
- ExitRich.ai (2026): business-valuation prototype with live scoring and advisor booking.
- Polk & Associates Construction (2024): company website. https://polkconstructiontn.com/
- Side projects: PickleTrack (computer-vision pickleball referee), FaceX (TrueDepth face scanning for custom-fit masks), Boston Dynamics' Spot programming, A-List Accessories (3D-printed décor shop).
